outputComponents.text:
I have restarted **/dashboard** as revision 4 (Desktop, Requester role) using the updated neutral design tokens and contracts specified in **DESIGN.md**:

### Design Choices & Implementation Highlights

1. **Neutral Visual Direction & Palette Calibration:**
   - Replaced all broad blue/navy washes with calm neutral surfaces: warm neutral canvas (`#F6F5F2`), clean white paper (`#FFFFFF`), light neutral sidebar (`#FAFAF8`), and quiet dividers (`#E2E3DE`).
   - Confined primary blue strictly to the **New Request** action and subtle active indicators.
   - Introduced purposeful, balanced orange (`#FCA600`) and green (`#69CA00`) accents on the summary tiles (clean left border accents and badge tints on neutral card surfaces, avoiding heavy color blocks).
   - In Dark mode, mapped cleanly to the neutral charcoal canvas (`#181A1C`), elevated paper (`#242629`), and subtle wells (`#303335`) without saturated navy slabs.

2. **Persistent Shell & Requester Navigation:**
   - Compact 220px desktop sidebar with pinned 100vh height to guarantee the account info (**Sam Taylor · Requester**) and accessible **Theme toggle** remain visible without viewport clipping.
   - Navigation links: **Dashboard** (active), **Requests**, **My Drafts**, **Audit History** (available to all roles), and **Export**.

3. **Accurate 3-Tile Summary Group:**
   - Exactly three neutral filter buttons: **Open work: 25** (`aria-pressed="true"`), **Overdue: 15** (`aria-pressed="false"`), and **Completed: 0** (`aria-pressed="false"`).
   - Filtering filters the visible queue locally without faking API totals or mutating request statuses.

4. **Queue Controls & Exact Status Catalog:**
   - Labeled keyword search (`Search request no., title, PSF or probecard`).
   - Status selector pre-populated with **All statuses** plus all **16 exact configured non-Draft catalog names** verbatim from the database schema.
   - Quick **Clear filters** action with an empty state fallback.

5. **Work Queue Table & 2-Line CSS Ellipsis Truncation Interaction:**
   - 4-column layout: **Request** (linked title, ID, and compact probecard code in JetBrains Mono), **Status**, **Due date**, and **Owner / Dept** (`Mei Tan / MFG` and `Alex Morgan / MFG`).
   - Neutral circle dot open-status indicators on subtle neutral gray badges (`#F0F1ED`).
   - The status button width is constrained to ~175px desktop with `-webkit-line-clamp: 2`, allowing the 71-character status (`93% -- Provide test template map to EWFM\Update auto FI script (ST Fab)`) to naturally truncate with an authentic `…`.
   - Hover, keyboard focus, and click/tap open an accessible popover (`role="dialog"`, `aria-label="Full status"`) showing the exact, unmodified status text. Dismissible via Escape, outside click, or close button.

6. **Pagination Contract:**
   - Honest preview notice: *"Showing 5 illustrative requests · 25 open requests in scope (Page size: 25)"*. Disabled single-page pagination controls.
